name: Carrot-Pear Soup with Cheddar & Strawberry-Orange Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 pear
2 medium carrots
2 sticks celery
½ lime
½ (16 oz) pkg strawberries
1 orange

instructions.primary_message: Quarter, core, and small dice pear. Place in a medium bowl. (Reserve a small handful of pear for serving.)
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Trim and small dice celery. Add both to the bowl with the pear.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
1 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pear, veggies, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1 tsp smoked paprika
salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice lime into a clean medium bowl. Add honey and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.

When the veggies have softened, add broth to the pan; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer; cook, stirring occasionally, until pear and veggies are tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: While the soup is cooking, trim and quarter strawberries lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel orange, separate into segments, and roughly chop the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop dates. Add to the bowl, along with pumpkin seeds, and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅛ cup medjool dates, pitted
¼ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate cheese. Set aside for serving.
When the pear and veggies are tender, using a hand blender, purée the soup until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pan.)
Divide soup between bowls, then top with cheese and reserved pear. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
